🇧🇷 Brazilian Financial Data APIs

Open-source REST APIs for Brazilian capital market public data

Services

:8000

CVM Credit Market API

CVM credit market data: FIDC, FIP, FIAGRO, and SECURIT datasets — cadastral records, monthly/quarterly reports, and emissions.

Swagger UI ReDoc Health
:8001

B3 CALC API

B3 CALC proxy for debentures, CRA, CRI pricing — security info, mark-to-market prices, financial indexes, and market data.

Swagger UI ReDoc Health
:8002

BACEN Data API

Banco Central do Brasil public data: SGS time series (SELIC, CDI, IPCA…), PTAX FX rates, Focus market expectations, and interest-rate statistics.

Swagger UI ReDoc Health

Key Endpoints — BACEN API

MethodPathDescription
GET/api/v1/bacen/sgs/well-knownList well-known SGS series codes
GET/api/v1/bacen/sgs/{code}Fetch a single SGS time series
GET/api/v1/bacen/sgs/multi?codes=IPCA:433,CDI:12Fetch multiple SGS series
GET/api/v1/bacen/ptax/dolar?date=USD/BRL PTAX rate for a date
GET/api/v1/bacen/ptax/dolar/periodo?start=&end=USD/BRL PTAX range
GET/api/v1/bacen/ptax/moeda/{moeda}?date=Any currency/BRL for a date
GET/api/v1/bacen/ptax/moeda/{moeda}/periodoAny currency/BRL range
GET/api/v1/bacen/ptax/moedasList all PTAX currencies
GET/api/v1/bacen/expectativasList expectations endpoints
GET/api/v1/bacen/expectativas/{endpoint}Query Focus expectations
GET/api/v1/bacen/taxas_juros/{endpoint}Query interest-rate data

Key Endpoints — CVM API

MethodPathDescription
GET/api/v1/entitiesList all entities and doc types
GET/api/v1/{entity}/{doc_type}Fetch dataset (paginated)
GET/api/v1/{entity}/{doc_type}?year=&month=Periodic dataset with date filter
GET/api/v1/fidc/cadastralFIDC fund registry
GET/api/v1/fidc/mensal?year=2024&month=6FIDC monthly report
